# Getting started

How to mount Northwind in this codebase.

## 1. Install and import the stylesheet

```bash
pnpm add @cortejojicoy/admin-kit
```

```ts
// app/layout.tsx
import '@cortejojicoy/admin-kit/styles.css'
```

## 2. Mount the provider

```tsx
// app/layout.tsx  (server component)
import { AdminProvider } from '@cortejojicoy/admin-kit/client'
import { serializeConfig } from '@cortejojicoy/admin-kit'
import { adminConfig } from '@/admin.config'
import '@cortejojicoy/admin-kit/styles.css'

export default function RootLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <html>
      <body>
        {/* serializeConfig strips functions so the config can cross into a client component */}
        <AdminProvider config={serializeConfig(adminConfig)} icons={icons}>
          {children}
        </AdminProvider>
      </body>
    </html>
  )
}
```

## 3. The panels

`/dashboard` renders the launcher:

```tsx
import { AppShell, AppLauncher } from '@cortejojicoy/admin-kit/ui'

export default function Page() {
  return (
    <AppShell>
      <AppLauncher />
    </AppShell>
  )
}
```

`/admin` renders the sidebar panel, guarded at the layout:

```tsx
// app/admin/layout.tsx
import { AdminShell } from '@cortejojicoy/admin-kit/ui'
import { getServerSession, rolesFromSession, requireAdmin } from '@cortejojicoy/admin-kit/server'
import { adminConfig } from '@/admin.config'
import { serverConfig } from '@/admin.server'

export default async function AdminLayout({ children }) {
  const session = await getServerSession(adminConfig, await requestFromHeaders(), { serverConfig })
  await requireAdmin(adminConfig, { roles: rolesFromSession(adminConfig, session) })
  return <AdminShell>{children}</AdminShell>
}
```

## 4. The login page

`/login` renders the sign-in form:

```tsx
import { LoginPage } from '@cortejojicoy/admin-kit/ui'

export default function Page() {
  return <LoginPage />
}
```

## 5. Protect the routes

```ts
// middleware.ts
import { createAdminMiddleware } from '@cortejojicoy/admin-kit/middleware'
import { adminConfig } from './admin.config'

export default createAdminMiddleware(adminConfig, { secret: process.env.JWT_SECRET })
export const config = { matcher: ['/((?!_next|api/auth|favicon).*)'] }
```

> Middleware redirects; it does not authorize. See [Access control](./access.md#guards).
